ble_219_0c043658.name: xStreamBufferSendFromISR
ble_219_0c043658.summary: FreeRTOS: copy data into a stream/message buffer from an ISR and wake the waiting reader
ble_219_0c043658.description: FreeRTOS stream_buffer.c xStreamBufferSendFromISR(xStreamBuffer, pvTxData, xDataLengthBytes, pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken). StreamBuffer_t layout: [0]=xTail, [1]=xHead, [2]=xLength, [3]=xTriggerLevelBytes, [4]=xTaskWaitingToReceive, [5]=xTaskWaitingToSend, [6]=pucBuffer, byte +0x1c=ucFlags (bit0 = sbFLAGS_IS_MESSAGE_BUFFER). Free space = (xTail + xLength - 1 - xHead) mod xLength. For a message buffer the whole message plus a 4-byte length header must fit, otherwise 0 is returned; the header is written first with prvWriteBytesToBuffer (0x0c0433d0). For a plain stream buffer the write is truncated to the free space. After a non-empty write, if the bytes now stored ((xHead + xLength - xTail) mod xLength) reach xTriggerLevelBytes, the sbSEND_COMPLETE_FROM_ISR step runs under rtos_enter_critical/rtos_exit_critical: xTaskGenericNotifyFromISR(xTaskWaitingToReceive, 0, eNoAction, NULL, pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken) and the waiting-task slot is cleared. No critical section protects the buffer write itself (single-writer assumption). Returns the number of payload bytes written.

returns.description: bytes actually written (0 if a message did not fit)

ble_219_0c043978.name: prvAddNewTaskToReadyList
ble_219_0c043978.summary: FreeRTOS: register a freshly created TCB with the scheduler and put it on its ready list
ble_219_0c043978.description: tasks.c prvAddNewTaskToReadyList(pxNewTCB). Inside vPortEnterCritical/vPortExitCritical (0x0c03f640/0x0c03f65c): increments uxCurrentNumberOfTasks (DAT_2000cc14); if this is the very first task it also runs prvInitialiseTaskLists inline, calling vListInitialise on the six ready lists pxReadyTasksLists[0..5] at 0x2000cb98 (20 bytes each, up to 0x2000cc10, so configMAX_PRIORITIES = 6), xDelayedTaskList1 (0x2000cc2c), xDelayedTaskList2 (0x2000cc40), xPendingReadyList (0x2000cc60), xTasksWaitingTermination (0x2000cc8c) and xSuspendedTaskList (0x2000cc78), and sets pxDelayedTaskList (DAT_2000cb90) / pxOverflowDelayedTaskList (DAT_2000cb94). pxCurrentTCB (DAT_2000cb8c) becomes the new task when it is NULL, or when the scheduler is not yet running (xSchedulerRunning DAT_2000cc74 == 0) and the new priority (TCB+0x2c) is >= the current one. uxTaskNumber (DAT_2000cc24) is incremented and stored as uxTCBNumber (TCB+0x44); uxTopReadyPriority (DAT_2000cc28) is raised if needed and the xStateListItem (TCB+4) is appended to pxReadyTasksLists[priority] with vListInsertEnd. If the scheduler is running and the new task has a strictly higher priority than pxCurrentTCB, rtos_pendsv_trigger requests a context switch. Called from xTaskCreateStatic / xTaskCreate (0x0c043cfc, 0x0c043d3c, 0x0c043e70).

ble_219_0c043a7c.name: prvAddCurrentTaskToDelayedList
ble_219_0c043a7c.summary: FreeRTOS: move the running task to the delayed, overflow-delayed or suspended list
ble_219_0c043a7c.description: tasks.c prvAddCurrentTaskToDelayedList(xTicksToWait, xCanBlockIndefinitely). Clears ucDelayAborted (TCB+0x5e) of pxCurrentTCB (DAT_2000cb8c) and unlinks its xStateListItem (TCB+4) from the ready list with uxListRemove. If xTicksToWait == portMAX_DELAY (0xffffffff) and blocking indefinitely is allowed, the item is appended to xSuspendedTaskList (0x2000cc78). Otherwise the wake time xTickCount (DAT_2000cca0) + xTicksToWait is stored as the item value; when that addition wraps the item goes into pxOverflowDelayedTaskList (DAT_2000cb94) via the sorted vListInsert, else into pxDelayedTaskList (DAT_2000cb90) and xNextTaskUnblockTime (DAT_2000cc58) is lowered to the wake time if earlier. The caller must hold the scheduler suspended or be in a critical section. Callers: vTaskDelay (0x0c0441a8), vTaskPlaceOnEventList, vTaskPlaceOnUnorderedEventList, vTaskPlaceOnEventListRestricted and xTaskNotifyWait.

ble_219_0c043ba8.name: prvInitialiseNewTask
ble_219_0c043ba8.summary: FreeRTOS: fill a TCB, paint the stack and build the initial context for a new task
ble_219_0c043ba8.description: tasks.c prvInitialiseNewTask(pxTaskCode, pcName, ulStackDepth, pvParameters, uxPriority, pxCreatedTask, pxNewTCB) without the MPU xRegions argument. Fills the stack (TCB+0x30 = pxStack) with tskSTACK_FILL_BYTE 0xa5 over ulStackDepth*4 bytes, copies up to 16 characters of the name into pcTaskName (TCB+0x34) and forces pcTaskName[15] = 0, clamps the priority to configMAX_PRIORITIES-1 = 5 and stores it in uxPriority (+0x2c) and uxBasePriority (+0x4c), zeroes uxMutexesHeld (+0x50), ulRunTimeCounter (+0x54), ulNotifiedValue (+0x58), ucNotifyState (+0x5c) and ucDelayAborted (+0x5e). Both list items are initialised with vListInitialiseItem: xStateListItem (+4, owner = TCB) and xEventListItem (+0x18, owner = TCB, value = 6 - priority so that higher priorities sort first). The top of stack is pxStack + depth*4 - 4 rounded down to 8 bytes; pxTopOfStack (+0) receives rtos_task_stack_init(top, pxStack (stack limit for PSPLIM), pxTaskCode, pvParameters). If pxCreatedTask is non-NULL the TCB pointer is returned through it. Called from the task-create routines 0x0c043cfc, 0x0c043d3c, 0x0c043e70.

params.name: param_4
params.description: pvParameters passed in r0 to the task

params.name: param_7
params.description: TCB_t* pxNewTCB to initialise (pxStack already set at +0x30)

ble_219_0c043f48.name: xTaskIncrementTick
ble_219_0c043f48.summary: FreeRTOS: advance xTickCount, unblock expired delayed tasks and report whether to switch
ble_219_0c043f48.description: tasks.c xTaskIncrementTick(), called from the SysTick handler (0x0c03f674) and from xTaskResumeAll for pended ticks. If uxSchedulerSuspended (DAT_2000cc20) is non-zero it only increments uxPendedTicks (DAT_2000cc1c) and still calls the (empty) vApplicationTickHook ble_stub_nop_0c047fe8. Otherwise xTickCount (DAT_2000cca0) is incremented; on wrap to 0 the delayed lists are swapped (pxDelayedTaskList DAT_2000cb90 <-> pxOverflowDelayedTaskList DAT_2000cb94), xNumOfOverflows (DAT_2000cc5c) incremented and xNextTaskUnblockTime (DAT_2000cc58) recomputed from the new list head. When the tick reaches xNextTaskUnblockTime every task at the head of pxDelayedTaskList whose item value <= tick is removed (uxListRemove on xStateListItem, and on xEventListItem +0x18 if its container +0x28 is set), uxTopReadyPriority (DAT_2000cc28) is updated and the task appended to pxReadyTasksLists[priority] (0x2000cb98 + prio*20); xSwitchRequired is set if its priority >= that of pxCurrentTCB. With time slicing, a switch is also requested when the ready list of the current priority holds more than one task. The tick hook is only invoked when no ticks were pended. Finally xYieldPending (DAT_2000cca4) forces a pdTRUE result.

returns.description: pdTRUE when a context switch should be performed

ble_219_0c0440ac.name: xTaskResumeAll
ble_219_0c0440ac.summary: FreeRTOS: resume the scheduler, drain the pending-ready list and replay pended ticks
ble_219_0c0440ac.description: tasks.c xTaskResumeAll(). Inside vPortEnterCritical/vPortExitCritical (0x0c03f640/0x0c03f65c) decrements uxSchedulerSuspended (DAT_2000cc20). When it reaches 0 and tasks exist (uxCurrentNumberOfTasks DAT_2000cc14 != 0): every task in xPendingReadyList (0x2000cc60, head owner via +0xc) is unlinked from both its xEventListItem (+0x18) and xStateListItem (+4) and appended to pxReadyTasksLists[uxPriority] (0x2000cb98 + prio*20), raising uxTopReadyPriority (DAT_2000cc28) and setting xYieldPending (DAT_2000cca4) when the task's priority >= pxCurrentTCB->uxPriority; xNextTaskUnblockTime (DAT_2000cc58) is reset from the head of pxDelayedTaskList (DAT_2000cb90) or to portMAX_DELAY. Then uxPendedTicks (DAT_2000cc1c) ticks are replayed by calling xTaskIncrementTick that many times. If a yield is pending, rtos_pendsv_trigger is called and pdTRUE returned (the caller already switched). Pairs with vTaskSuspendAll; used by queue, timer, event-group and notification code (many callers).

returns.description: pdTRUE if a context switch was requested, else pdFALSE

ble_219_0c0441f0.name: vTaskPlaceOnEventList
ble_219_0c0441f0.summary: FreeRTOS: block the current task on a sorted event list with a timeout
ble_219_0c0441f0.description: tasks.c vTaskPlaceOnEventList(pxEventList, xTicksToWait). Inserts pxCurrentTCB->xEventListItem (DAT_2000cb8c + 0x18) into the given event list with the priority-sorted vListInsert (item value = 6 - priority, so highest priority wakes first), then calls prvAddCurrentTaskToDelayedList(xTicksToWait, pdTRUE). Must be called with the scheduler suspended; used by the queue send/receive/semaphore-take paths (0x0c042c8c, 0x0c042fa4, 0x0c0430a8, 0x0c043224) to block on xTasksWaitingToSend/Receive.

params.name: param_1
params.description: List_t* event list to wait on

ble_219_0c044210.name: vTaskPlaceOnUnorderedEventList
ble_219_0c044210.summary: FreeRTOS: block the current task on an unordered event list (event groups)
ble_219_0c044210.description: tasks.c vTaskPlaceOnUnorderedEventList(pxEventList, xItemValue, xTicksToWait). Stores xItemValue | taskEVENT_LIST_ITEM_VALUE_IN_USE (0x80000000) in pxCurrentTCB->xEventListItem.xItemValue (DAT_2000cb8c + 0x18), appends the item to the list with vListInsertEnd (FIFO, not priority ordered) and calls prvAddCurrentTaskToDelayedList(xTicksToWait, pdTRUE). The item value carries the event-group wait bits/flags and is read back by uxTaskResetEventItemValue. Single caller: the event-group wait routine 0x0c042858.

params.name: param_2
params.description: xItemValue (bits to wait for plus control flags)

ble_219_0c044238.name: vTaskPlaceOnEventListRestricted
ble_219_0c044238.summary: FreeRTOS: block the current task on an event list, optionally forever (timer task)
ble_219_0c044238.description: tasks.c vTaskPlaceOnEventListRestricted(pxEventList, xTicksToWait, xWaitIndefinitely). Appends pxCurrentTCB->xEventListItem (DAT_2000cb8c + 0x18) to the list with vListInsertEnd; if xWaitIndefinitely is set the wait is forced to portMAX_DELAY, then prvAddCurrentTaskToDelayedList(xTicksToWait, xWaitIndefinitely) is called. Used only by the timer-service path (prvProcessTimerOrBlockTask, 0x0c043380, blocking on the timer command queue at +0x24 of the queue struct).

ble_219_0c044264.name: xTaskRemoveFromEventList
ble_219_0c044264.summary: FreeRTOS: wake the highest-priority task blocked on an event list
ble_219_0c044264.description: tasks.c xTaskRemoveFromEventList(pxEventList). Takes the TCB owning the head entry (list +0xc -> item, item +0xc -> owner), removes its xEventListItem (+0x18). If the scheduler is running (uxSchedulerSuspended DAT_2000cc20 == 0) it also removes the xStateListItem (+4) from the delayed list, updates uxTopReadyPriority (DAT_2000cc28) and appends the task to pxReadyTasksLists[uxPriority] (0x2000cb98 + prio*20); otherwise the event item is parked on xPendingReadyList (0x2000cc60) for xTaskResumeAll. Returns pdTRUE and sets xYieldPending (DAT_2000cca4) when the woken task has a higher priority than pxCurrentTCB (DAT_2000cb8c + 0x2c). Called from the queue/semaphore code (8 callers) after data or space becomes available.

returns.description: pdTRUE if the unblocked task should pre-empt the caller

ble_219_0c0442e4.name: vTaskRemoveFromUnorderedEventList
ble_219_0c0442e4.summary: FreeRTOS: wake a task from an unordered event list and hand it the result value
ble_219_0c0442e4.description: tasks.c vTaskRemoveFromUnorderedEventList(pxEventListItem, xItemValue). Writes xItemValue | 0x80000000 (taskEVENT_LIST_ITEM_VALUE_IN_USE) into the list item, fetches its owner TCB (+0xc), removes the event item and the task's xStateListItem (+4), raises uxTopReadyPriority (DAT_2000cc28) and appends the task to pxReadyTasksLists[uxPriority] (0x2000cb98 + prio*20). If the woken task outranks pxCurrentTCB (DAT_2000cb8c + 0x2c) xYieldPending (DAT_2000cca4) is set so the caller yields after resuming the scheduler. Must be called with the scheduler suspended. Single caller: the event-group set-bits routine 0x0c04291c. The extra decompiled arguments param_3/param_4 are artefacts.

params.name: param_1
params.description: ListItem_t* xEventListItem of the task to wake

ble_219_0c04433c.name: vTaskSetTimeOutState
ble_219_0c04433c.summary: FreeRTOS: record overflow count and tick count in a TimeOut_t inside a critical section
ble_219_0c04433c.description: tasks.c vTaskSetTimeOutState(pxTimeOut): the public, critical-section-protected version of vTaskInternalSetTimeOutState (0x0c044360). Between vPortEnterCritical/vPortExitCritical (0x0c03f640/0x0c03f65c) it stores xNumOfOverflows (DAT_2000cc5c) in [0] (xOverflowCount) and xTickCount (DAT_2000cca0) in [1] (xTimeOnEntering). Used by the stream-buffer receive path (0x0c043554) before blocking with xTaskNotifyWait.

ble_219_0c044378.name: xTaskCheckForTimeOut
ble_219_0c044378.summary: FreeRTOS: test whether a blocking timeout expired and adjust the remaining ticks
ble_219_0c044378.description: tasks.c xTaskCheckForTimeOut(pxTimeOut, pxTicksToWait), inside vPortEnterCritical/vPortExitCritical. First checks ucDelayAborted (pxCurrentTCB DAT_2000cb8c + 0x5e): if set it is cleared and pdTRUE returned (xTaskAbortDelay support). If *pxTicksToWait == portMAX_DELAY the result is pdFALSE (wait forever). If the overflow counter changed (pxTimeOut[0] != xNumOfOverflows DAT_2000cc5c) and xTickCount (DAT_2000cca0) already passed xTimeOnEntering, the timeout is pdTRUE. Else elapsed = xTickCount - xTimeOnEntering: if elapsed < *pxTicksToWait the remaining ticks are written back, the TimeOut_t is refreshed to now and pdFALSE returned; otherwise *pxTicksToWait = 0 and pdTRUE. Callers: queue send/receive/semaphore (0x0c042c8c, 0x0c042fa4, 0x0c0430a8, 0x0c043224) and stream-buffer receive (0x0c043554).

params.name: param_2
params.description: TickType_t* ticks still to wait, updated in place

returns.description: pdTRUE if the timeout has expired

ble_219_0c044658.name: xTaskPriorityInherit
ble_219_0c044658.summary: FreeRTOS: raise a mutex holder's priority to that of the current task
ble_219_0c044658.description: tasks.c xTaskPriorityInherit(pxMutexHolder). Returns pdFALSE for a NULL holder. If the holder's uxPriority (+0x2c) is already >= pxCurrentTCB's, it returns whether uxBasePriority (+0x4c) < current priority (i.e. an inheritance already happened). Otherwise it inherits: if xEventListItem.xItemValue (+0x18) is not flagged in-use (bit 31 clear) it is set to 6 - current priority; if the holder sits in its ready list (xStateListItem container +0x14 == &pxReadyTasksLists[old prio]) it is moved to pxReadyTasksLists[new prio] (0x2000cb98 + prio*20, uxTopReadyPriority DAT_2000cc28 updated), otherwise only uxPriority is rewritten. Returns pdTRUE when the priority changed. Caller: the semaphore/mutex take path 0x0c0430a8 when the mutex is held by a lower-priority task.

params.name: param_1
params.description: TCB_t* current mutex holder (may be NULL)

ble_219_0c0446e4.name: xTaskPriorityDisinherit
ble_219_0c0446e4.summary: FreeRTOS: drop an inherited priority when the last held mutex is released
ble_219_0c0446e4.description: tasks.c xTaskPriorityDisinherit(pxMutexHolder). Returns 0 for a NULL holder. Decrements uxMutexesHeld (+0x50); if the task runs at an inherited priority (uxPriority +0x2c != uxBasePriority +0x4c) and now holds no mutexes, it is removed from its ready list, xEventListItem.xItemValue (+0x18) is reset to 6 - base priority, uxPriority restored to the base priority, uxTopReadyPriority (DAT_2000cc28) updated and the task appended to pxReadyTasksLists[base] (0x2000cb98 + prio*20); returns pdTRUE so the caller yields. Called from the mutex give path 0x0c042a3c.

returns.description: pdTRUE if the holder's priority was lowered

ble_219_0c044744.name: vTaskPriorityDisinheritAfterTimeout
ble_219_0c044744.summary: FreeRTOS: lower a mutex holder's priority after a waiter timed out
ble_219_0c044744.description: tasks.c vTaskPriorityDisinheritAfterTimeout(pxMutexHolder, uxHighestPriorityWaitingTask). Ignores NULL. uxPriorityToUse = max(uxBasePriority +0x4c, highest waiting priority). Only acts when uxPriority (+0x2c) differs and the holder holds exactly one mutex (uxMutexesHeld +0x50 == 1): writes the new priority, updates xEventListItem.xItemValue (+0x18) to 6 - priority unless bit 31 (in-use) is set, and if the task is in its ready list (container +0x14 == &pxReadyTasksLists[old]) moves it to pxReadyTasksLists[new] (0x2000cb98 + prio*20) adjusting uxTopReadyPriority (DAT_2000cc28). Called from the semaphore take path 0x0c0430a8 when a mutex wait times out.

params.name: param_2
params.description: highest priority among tasks still waiting for the mutex

ble_219_0c0447e8.name: xTaskNotifyWait
ble_219_0c0447e8.summary: FreeRTOS: wait for a task notification, clearing bits on entry and exit
ble_219_0c0447e8.description: tasks.c xTaskNotifyWait(ulBitsToClearOnEntry, ulBitsToClearOnExit, pulNotificationValue, xTicksToWait) operating on pxCurrentTCB (DAT_2000cb8c): ulNotifiedValue at +0x58, ucNotifyState at +0x5c (0 = not waiting, 1 = waiting, 2 = notification received). First critical section (vPortEnterCritical/vPortExitCritical 0x0c03f640/0x0c03f65c): if no notification is pending, clears the entry bits, sets state = waiting and, if xTicksToWait != 0, calls prvAddCurrentTaskToDelayedList and rtos_pendsv_trigger to block. Second critical section after wake-up: optionally returns the value through pulNotificationValue, returns pdTRUE if state == received (clearing the exit bits), pdFALSE on timeout, and resets the state to not-waiting. Callers: the stream-buffer send/receive blocking paths 0x0c043554 and 0x0c0436f8.

returns.description: pdTRUE if a notification was received, pdFALSE on timeout

ble_219_0c044870.name: xTaskGenericNotify
ble_219_0c044870.summary: FreeRTOS: send a task notification from task context and unblock the target
ble_219_0c044870.description: tasks.c xTaskGenericNotify(xTaskToNotify, ulValue, eAction, pulPreviousNotificationValue) inside vPortEnterCritical/vPortExitCritical. Optionally returns the old ulNotifiedValue (+0x58), remembers the old ucNotifyState (+0x5c) and sets it to 2 (received). eAction: 1 eSetBits -> value |= ulValue; 2 eIncrement -> value++; 3 eSetValueWithOverwrite -> value = ulValue; 4 eSetValueWithoutOverwrite -> value = ulValue only if no notification was pending, otherwise returns pdFAIL (0); 0 eNoAction leaves the value. If the target was waiting (old state 1) it is removed from its blocked list (xStateListItem +4), uxTopReadyPriority (DAT_2000cc28) updated, appended to pxReadyTasksLists[uxPriority] (0x2000cb98 + prio*20) and rtos_pendsv_trigger issued when it outranks pxCurrentTCB (DAT_2000cb8c + 0x2c). Returns pdPASS otherwise. Callers: stream-buffer send/receive completion (0x0c043554, 0x0c0436f8, 0x0c043830, 0x0c0438d8).

params.name: param_3
params.description: eNotifyAction (0 none, 1 set bits, 2 increment, 3 overwrite, 4 no-overwrite)

params.name: param_4
params.description: uint32_t* previous value output (may be NULL)

returns.description: pdPASS, or pdFAIL when eSetValueWithoutOverwrite found a pending notification

ble_219_0c044914.name: xTaskGenericNotifyFromISR
ble_219_0c044914.summary: FreeRTOS: send a task notification from an ISR and flag a higher-priority wake-up
ble_219_0c044914.description: tasks.c xTaskGenericNotifyFromISR(xTaskToNotify, ulValue, eAction, pulPreviousNotificationValue, pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken). Same value update as xTaskGenericNotify (eAction 1 set bits, 2 increment, 3 overwrite, 4 overwrite-only-if-idle returning pdFAIL otherwise) but protected with rtos_enter_critical/rtos_exit_critical (portSET/CLEAR_INTERRUPT_MASK_FROM_ISR). If the target was waiting (ucNotifyState +0x5c == 1): when the scheduler is running (uxSchedulerSuspended DAT_2000cc20 == 0) the task is moved from its blocked list to pxReadyTasksLists[uxPriority] (0x2000cb98 + prio*20, uxTopReadyPriority DAT_2000cc28 updated); otherwise its xEventListItem (+0x18) is parked on xPendingReadyList (0x2000cc60). If the woken task outranks pxCurrentTCB, *pxHigherPriorityTaskWoken = pdTRUE when the pointer is given, else xYieldPending (DAT_2000cca4) is set. Callers: xStreamBufferSendFromISR and the ISR send/receive-completed helpers 0x0c043830, 0x0c0438d8.

params.name: param_4
params.description: uint32_t* previous value output (may be NULL)

returns.description: pdPASS, or pdFAIL for eSetValueWithoutOverwrite with a pending notification

ble_219_0c0449fc.name: xTaskNotifyStateClear
ble_219_0c0449fc.summary: FreeRTOS: clear a pending notification state of a task (or the current task)
ble_219_0c0449fc.description: tasks.c xTaskNotifyStateClear(xTask). A NULL handle means pxCurrentTCB (DAT_2000cb8c). Inside vPortEnterCritical/vPortExitCritical: if ucNotifyState (+0x5c) == 2 (notification received) it is reset to 0 and pdTRUE returned, otherwise pdFALSE. The notification value itself is untouched. Callers: the stream-buffer blocking paths 0x0c043554 and 0x0c0436f8 (sbRECEIVE_COMPLETED / sbSEND_COMPLETED housekeeping).

params.name: param_1
params.description: TaskHandle_t, NULL for the calling task

returns.description: pdTRUE if a pending notification was cleared

ble_219_0c044bb0.name: prvInsertTimerInActiveList
ble_219_0c044bb0.summary: FreeRTOS timers: queue a software timer in the current or overflow timer list
ble_219_0c044bb0.description: timers.c prvInsertTimerInActiveList(pxTimer, xNextExpiryTime, xTimeNow, xCommandTime). Timer_t layout: +4 xTimerListItem (xItemValue +4, pvOwner +0x10, pvContainer +0x14), +0x18 xTimerPeriodInTicks. Sets the item owner and value = expiry time. If the expiry is still in the future and the command was not issued after a tick wrap, the item is inserted (sorted) into pxCurrentTimerList (DAT_2000cca8); if the expiry already wrapped but less than one period has elapsed since the command, it goes into pxOverflowTimerList (DAT_2000ccac). In both insert cases, if the item currently sits in the third list at 0x2000ddb8 (a BES addition to the two active lists initialised in 0x0c044aa4) it is first unlinked with uxListRemove. Returns 1 (xProcessTimerNow) when the timer must be processed immediately instead. Called by the timer command processor 0x0c044ee8 (prvProcessReceivedCommands).

params.name: param_4
params.description: xCommandTime (ticks when the command was queued)

returns.description: 1 if the timer has already expired and must be processed now, 0 if queued

ble_219_0c044bb0.notes: The uxListRemove-when-in-list-0x2000ddb8 check is not in stock FreeRTOS; purpose of that list is unknown.

ble_219_0c045494.name: hal_time_ms
ble_219_0c045494.summary: BTstack run-loop port: current time in milliseconds derived from the FreeRTOS tick count
ble_219_0c045494.description: Reads xTaskGetTickCount(), multiplies by 1000 as a 64-bit value and divides it by 1000 with the 64-bit divide helper 0x0c06fec0 (__udivmoddi4 wrapper), i.e. ticks * 1000 / configTICK_RATE_HZ with a 1 kHz tick, so the result equals the tick count in milliseconds. Single caller is the embedded run-loop execute routine 0x0c05d108, matching BTstack's btstack_run_loop_embedded_get_time_ms() -> hal_time_ms() hook. The decompiler shows no return but the quotient is left in r0/r1.

returns.description: milliseconds since scheduler start (low word of the 64-bit quotient)

ble_219_0c045534.name: hci_stream_buffer_is_empty
ble_219_0c045534.summary: Return true when the 5 KB HCI stream buffer holds no bytes
ble_219_0c045534.description: Calls ringbuf_used_count on the FreeRTOS stream-buffer handle DAT_2000f2b0 and returns count == 0. The handle is created in the HCI 'intersys' transport open routine 0x0c04542c with xStreamBufferGenericCreateStatic(0x1400 bytes, trigger level 1, storage 0x2000de8c) and is filled by xStreamBufferSend in 0x0c045518. Used by the transport poll routine 0x0c05d40e to decide whether a pending read callback (0x0c05d2f4) must run.

returns.description: true if no HCI bytes are buffered

ble_219_0c04555c.name: hal_dma0_irq_handler
ble_219_0c04555c.summary: IRQ3 vector: dispatch pending channel interrupts of DMA controller 0 (0x40120000)
ble_219_0c04555c.description: Exception vector IRQ3_Handler. Reads the PL08x-style DMACIntStatus register at 0x40120000 (controller 0, AUDMA in BES naming) and for each of the 8 channels whose bit is set calls hal_gpdma_chan_irq_handler(0, channel), which clears the TC/error flags and runs the registered callback. Returns the last callback result or 3 if no channel was pending (value unused by the NVIC). Companion of hal_dma1_irq_handler.

returns.description: last hal_gpdma_chan_irq_handler result, 3 if nothing was pending

ble_219_0c04555c.notes: The harness lists RAM 0x2000f4d8 (= handler table 0x2000f4cc + 3*4) as read; the decompiled body does not show it.

ble_219_0c04556c.name: hal_dma1_irq_handler
ble_219_0c04556c.summary: IRQ4 vector: dispatch pending channel interrupts of DMA controller 1 (0x40130000)
ble_219_0c04556c.description: Exception vector IRQ4_Handler, identical to hal_dma0_irq_handler but for the second PL08x-style controller: reads DMACIntStatus at 0x40130000 (GPDMA in BES naming) and calls hal_gpdma_chan_irq_handler(1, channel) for every set bit of channels 0..7. Returns the last callback result or 4 when nothing was pending.

returns.description: last hal_gpdma_chan_irq_handler result, 4 if nothing was pending
